profile.name: Shivam Deolankar
profile.summary:
I'm a systems programmer with 3 years of experience working with C and Rust, mostly interested in the stuff that happens underneath the abstractions — OS internals, RTOS, device drivers, build systems, and debugging. I like knowing how things actually work, and sometimes breaking them just to figure out why.

I spend most of my time close to the metal, somewhere between hardware and software, figuring out why something decided to stop working at 2 AM. Working with RTEMS and contributing upstream has taught me to care about reproducible builds, proper failure handling, and writing systems that don’t fall apart when things go wrong.

Outside of systems, I like messing around with design, interfaces, typography, and generally making things look and feel a little more interesting. I’m also really into video games and the mix of engineering, art, mechanics, and storytelling that goes into making them. I like tinkering more than necessary as evident from this portfolio.

experience.title: ML Research Intern @ ABV-IIITM Gwalior
experience.subtitle: Adaptive Wavelet Attention for improving Energy Forecasting Models
bullets: Developed a Band Attention module for SimpleTM, inspired by FEDformer's frequency domain approach.
Enabled adaptive frequency weighting through wavelet bands to capture multi-scale patterns in SHEERM House electricity load consumption dataset.
Improved forecasting accuracy across 5+ horizons, achieving 23.5% higher R2, 17.4% higher EVS, and 1.3% lower MSE.

experience.title: RTEMS - Real Time Operating System
experience.subtitle: Open Source Contributor
bullets: Resolved a Stack Checker Reporter defect by restructuring flag handling and decoupling SECTION FLAGS from COMPILER FLAGS, eliminating flag conflicts and ensuring consistent configuration, improving overall build reliability.

Resolved POSIX B0 baud rate edge case issue across UART drivers for 13 BSPs and drivers, implementing runtime safeguard mechanisms to prevent divide-by-zero, and standardizing termios handling for robust serial communication.

Implemented fallback-safe MMU mapping for missing PCIe nodes in device trees, ensuring reliable handling of incomplete hardware descriptions and enabling stable boot with correct memory initialization across BSP environments.
Migrated FatFS codebase, fixed error.h macro conflicts and libdl overflow, improving build stability and safety.

projects.title: SMTP Server
projects.subtitle: Custom SMTP Server using Golang (smtpd), Node.js (smtp-server), AWS EC2, Cloudflare DNS
bullets: Implemented a custom AWS EC2 instance to securely handle incoming emails using a self-managed infrastructure.

Integrated the instance with a custom domain via Cloudflare DNS by setting up isolated MX records, effectively masking the personal email address and enforcing strict receive-only protocols for enhanced security and privacy.

projects.title: PikaNote
projects.subtitle: A lightweight terminal text editor in Rust featuring efficient rendering and low-level control.
bullets: Implemented rich text editing features including insertion, deletion, line breaks, cursor navigation, and file I/O.
Built real-time terminal interaction using Crossterm, handling key events and dynamic cursor control responsively.
Implemented incremental screen rendering using queued terminal updates to minimize redraw overhead efficiently.
Developed bidirectional incremental search with live highlighting using an annotated string system for large buffers.
Designed a modular terminal UI with 3 components including editor view, message/command bar and a status bar.

projects.title: IIITM Alumni Directory
projects.subtitle: Alumni directory backed by structured MongoDB data, optimized search, filtering and data processing.
bullets: Handled and modified the MongoDB database containing 4500+ alumni records, preprocessing and restructuring raw data into consistent, searchable schemas.
Built regex-based search and filtering logic across alumni fields, handling inconsistent entries, aliases and missing data to improve query accuracy.
Optimized directory queries by structuring fields and applying targeted filters, making alumni records faster to search and easier to navigate.
Cleaned and normalized large sets of alumni data before integrating them into the public directory, improving data consistency and reliability.
Worked on the directory's data and search layer to support efficient discovery across batches, companies, expertise and other alumni attributes.

projects.title: IIITM Campus Marketplace
projects.subtitle: A campus marketplace prototype exploring HCI principles, user behaviour, and Neo-Brutalist interface design.
bullets: Listed everything from a black man to quirky items to our astonishing professor as 'products' — because obviously that was the most simplest to test a campus marketplace attracting 100+ users.
Applied HCI principles including user feedback, affordances, visual hierarchy, consistency, and feedback-driven interface decisions to study how students interacted with the marketplace.
Designed the interface around a Neo-Brutalist visual language with bold typography, high-contrast elements, hard borders, strong shadows, and intentionally raw visual styling.
Conducted usability testing with 100+ students to observe navigation patterns, interaction behaviour, and discoverability issues across the marketplace experience.
Iterated on the UI based on user observations and feedback, refining information hierarchy, product discovery, interactions, and overall usability.

projects.title: Secure UWCN Authentication Protocol
projects.subtitle: Lightweight mutual authentication protocol for secure underwater wireless communication networks.
bullets: Implemented and simulated a lightweight multi-hop authentication protocol for underwater networks spanning sensors, submarines, buoys, satellites and a base station.
Combined ECDH key exchange, AES-GCM encryption, and nonce-timestamp validation to provide mutual authentication while addressing replay and impersonation attacks.
Built a Python simulation modelling underwater-specific constraints including packet loss, propagation delay, node mobility, bandwidth and energy limitations.
Formally verified the protocol using Scyther against a Dolev-Yao attacker model, validating security properties including secrecy, aliveness, weak agreement and non-injective agreement.
Implemented dynamic route fallback to maintain authenticated communication when an intermediate buoy or satellite path becomes unavailable.

projects.title: LunarTriGSM
projects.subtitle: Triangle-based lunar crater matching for precision terrain-relative navigation.
bullets: Extended a triangle-based crater matching algorithm using the LRO NAC dataset with 13,453 training and 9,797 test crater annotations across 20 lunar images.
Upgraded crater detection from YOLOv8n to YOLOv8s and achieved 0.617 precision, 0.232 recall and 0.416 mAP@50 for automated crater localization.
Extended the first-order descriptor from 3D to 5D with crater-radius ratios and expanded the second-order descriptor from 12D to 25D using 4 neighbouring triangles.
Implemented adaptive similarity thresholds, confidence-weighted voting and RANSAC-based geometric verification to improve global crater correspondence and suppress false matches.
Reduced navigation position error by 31.2% in X and 33.1% in Y, achieving 100% navigation success while maintaining 0.157s average matching time.
Evaluated robustness using Monte Carlo simulations with 5-pixel Gaussian detection noise, maintaining 99.5% navigation success at 10% detection error.

projects.title: ChurnAware
projects.subtitle: Sentiment-aware customer churn prediction and retention optimization platform.
bullets: Built a churn prediction pipeline using RFM/R+FMD features, customer behaviour and review sentiment to identify customers at risk of leaving.
Used Gaussian Mixture Models to segment customers into 4 behavioural groups and a Random Forest model to estimate 90-day churn probability without temporal data leakage.
Developed a Double DQN retention engine that selects between 4 interventions based on predicted customer behaviour, incentive cost and long-term profit.
Built the serving layer with FastAPI and SQLite, with Next.js and Streamlit dashboards for customer segments, churn risk, KPIs and retention recommendations.
Evaluated the churn model on an unseen temporal snapshot of 1,574 customers, achieving 0.806 F1 for the churned class.

projects.title: YatraMitra
projects.subtitle: A full-stack travel booking platform for train, flight and bus ticket reservations.
bullets: Collaborated on a full-stack travel booking platform supporting train, flight and bus reservations with authentication and responsive user flows.
Built and integrated the frontend with the backend API, connecting booking workflows, user data and server-side routes into a complete application.
Implemented Stripe-based payment processing and checkout flows for handling ticket reservations.
Structured the backend with separate routes, models, middleware and database connection layers to keep the application modular and maintainable.
Designed a responsive frontend with interactive navigation, booking forms and a media-driven landing page for a smoother travel-booking experience.

projects.title: Hardware Projects
projects.subtitle: Embedded hardware projects involving sensors, real-time control, telemetry and embedded ML.
bullets: Built an avionics telemetry tool processing 100+ records, with validation, filtering and anomaly detection for 15+ telemetry issues.
Developed a gesture-controlled Glove Mouse using ESP32 and MPU6050, mapping gyroscope data to real-time cursor movement.
Built an Arduino-based rotten fruit segregation system using ML classification and servo-driven actuation for automated sorting.

projects.title: KoinX Reconciliation Engine
projects.subtitle: Transaction reconciliation engine built with Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB.
bullets: Built a transaction reconciliation engine that ingests, validates, normalizes and reconciles user and exchange CSV data.
Implemented matching with timestamp and quantity tolerances, categorizing transactions into MATCHED, CONFLICTING, USER_ONLY and EXCHANGE_ONLY.
Added duplicate detection and validation for missing fields, invalid quantities, timestamps and transaction prices while retaining invalid records for traceability.
Developed reporting APIs for reconciliation summaries, unmatched transactions and downloadable CSV reports, with results persisted in MongoDB.
Deployed the Node.js and Express.js backend on Render with MongoDB Atlas for persistent transaction and reconciliation data.
